Authenticate against the Zwift game API

Source: R/zwift.R
zwift_auth.Rd

Performs an OAuth2 password-grant login and returns a handle that refreshes the access token automatically. Requires your own Zwift credentials.

Usage

zwift_auth(
  username = Sys.getenv("ZWIFT_USERNAME"),
  password = Sys.getenv("ZWIFT_PASSWORD")
)

Arguments

username, password

Zwift account credentials. Default to the environment variables ZWIFT_USERNAME / ZWIFT_PASSWORD.

Value

An object of class zwift_auth.

Details

Token handling:

  • Expiry times are measured from when the token request was sent, and a token is renewed early (10% of its lifetime, 5–60 s), so slow responses and modest clock skew don't produce expired tokens.

  • When the access token expires the refresh token is used; if Zwift rejects the refresh (expired or revoked server-side), the handle logs in again with the password instead of failing.

  • A refresh_expires_in of 0 (a Keycloak offline token) never expires.

  • If the API answers 401 to a token the handle still thought valid, zwift_get() / zwift_post() discard it and retry the request once.

The handle exposes token(), login(), refresh() and invalidate(); printing it shows token status only, never the token or credentials.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
za <- zwift_auth()   # credentials from ZWIFT_USERNAME / ZWIFT_PASSWORD
za                   # token status, never the token itself
zwift_profile(za)
} # }
